# ScriptServerPlayer

*Server* · extends [`ScriptServerEntity`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerEntity)

Controls a server player, including microphone state, voice groups and effects. Voice effects run on clients: microphone effects before encoding, and listener effects after decoding. Server methods synchronize settings without processing audio.

## Methods

### getMinecraftPlayer {#getminecraftplayer}

::: member

**Returns** `ServerPlayerEntity` — the Minecraft player this wrapper controls, for Java code

:::

### createDisplayForm {#createdisplayform}

::: member

Creates a display of this player's current BBS form with a random UUID as its ID. Uses the live form and its existing animations: movement, head and body rotation, equipment and script animations follow the player automatically. Later form replacements are reflected; a player without a form is not rendered. The player must be loaded on each viewer's client. The display follows respawns and dimension changes. Configure it before calling [`show()`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm#show); run on the server thread.

```js
var target = c.getServer().getPlayer("Target");
if (target !== null) {
    target.createDisplayForm().setThroughWalls(true).addViewer(c.getPlayer()).show();
}
```

**Returns** [`ScriptServerDisplayForm`](/scripting/server/ScriptServerDisplayForm) — display not yet shown; visible to everyone, without a lifetime limit, rotating with the player, hidden from the player's own first-person camera. Through-wall rendering is off by default.

:::

### setKeybindCombo {#setkeybindcombo}

::: member

Assigns a personal keyboard combination to a Scram keybind and sends it only to this player. Saved in this world's player data and retained after reconnecting and respawning. Shared triggers stay unchanged. Unknown IDs remain inactive until the keybind exists. Run on the server thread.

```js
c.getPlayer().setKeybindCombo("dash", 341, 71); // Left Ctrl + G
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keybind ID, nonblank, at most 128 characters |
| `keys` | `int[]` | GLFW keyboard codes (32..348), at most 16; empty disables the binding for this player |

:::

### getKeybindCombo {#getkeybindcombo}

::: member

Returns this player's effective combination, inheriting the shared keybind unless overridden.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keybind ID, nonblank, at most 128 characters |

**Returns** `int[]` — independent GLFW keyboard-code array; empty when no keys are assigned

:::

### resetKeybindCombo {#resetkeybindcombo}

::: member

Removes this player's saved override and restores the shared combination, including future catalog changes. Run on the server thread. Does nothing beyond synchronization if no override exists.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keybind ID, nonblank, at most 128 characters |

:::

### pressKey {#presskey}

::: member

Presses a key on this player's client for one tick; see [`pressKey(String, int)`](#presskey).

```js
c.getPlayer().pressKey("space");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keyboard key name from options.txt, with or without the `key.keyboard.` prefix, case-insensitive: `"a"` .. `"z"`, `"0"` .. `"9"`, `"f1"` .. `"f25"`, `"space"`, `"enter"`, `"escape"`, `"tab"`, `"backspace"`, `"left.shift"`, `"left.control"`, `"left.alt"`, `"up"`, `"down"`, `"left"`, `"right"`, `"keypad.1"` and so on. |

:::

### pressKey {#presskey-2}

::: member

Simulates a key press on this player's client and holds the key for the given number of ticks. The press goes through Minecraft's keyboard handler like a real one: the open screen, vanilla key bindings (jump, inventory, drop, perspective...), other mods and Scram keybinds react to it. Code that reads the physical keyboard directly does not see it, so a held Shift or Ctrl does not act as a modifier for other keys. The key is released after `ticks` client ticks, or when the player leaves the world; pressing a held key presses it again. The client checks the name: unknown names are ignored there and logged in the client log.

```js
c.getPlayer().pressKey("w", 40);
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `key` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | keyboard key name from options.txt, with or without the `key.keyboard.` prefix, case-insensitive: `"a"` .. `"z"`, `"0"` .. `"9"`, `"f1"` .. `"f25"`, `"space"`, `"enter"`, `"escape"`, `"tab"`, `"backspace"`, `"left.shift"`, `"left.control"`, `"left.alt"`, `"up"`, `"down"`, `"left"`, `"right"`, `"keypad.1"` and so on. |
| `ticks` | [`int`](/scripting/js/Number) | client ticks to hold the key, from 1 to 12000 (10 minutes) |

:::

### openGUI {#opengui}

::: member

Opens a Minecraft screen on this player's client, replacing the open one, as if the player opened it. Screens with a back button return to the screen that was open before.

```js
c.getPlayer().openGUI("advancements");
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | screen ID: `"inventory"` (creative inventory in creative mode), `"chat"`, `"command"` (chat starting with /), `"pause"`, `"options"`, `"controls"`, `"keybinds"`, `"mouse"`, `"video"`, `"sound"`, `"language"`, `"chat_options"`, `"skin"`, `"accessibility"`, `"advancements"`, `"stats"` or `"social"` (player interactions) |

:::

### closeGUI {#closegui}

::: member

Closes any screen open on this player's client, including chests and other containers, and returns the player to the game.

```js
c.getPlayer().closeGUI();
```

:::

### muteVoice {#mutevoice}

::: member

Blocks this player's microphone for all listeners. The flag is saved in player data and does not change the client's microphone button. Call it on the Minecraft server thread; the client's microphone history is cleared.

:::

### unmuteVoice {#unmutevoice}

::: member

Allows this player's microphone packets through the server again. Call it on the Minecraft server thread; the client's microphone history is cleared.

:::

### isVoiceMuted {#isvoicemuted}

::: member

Checks the server's microphone mute flag, independent of the client's mute button.

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if this player's microphone is blocked by Scram

:::

### joinVoiceGroup {#joinvoicegroup}

::: member

Moves this player into a voice group, including hidden and password protected groups. This administrative operation does not require the password. Call it on the Minecraft server thread.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `groupId` | `UUID` | the group UUID returned by ScriptServer.createVoiceGroup() or getVoiceGroupId(); null returns false |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if the player joined; false if the group or connection is unavailable or another plugin rejects the change

:::

### joinVoiceGroupByName {#joinvoicegroupbyname}

::: member

Joins the first voice group with an exact, case-sensitive name. Uses the same administrative access and server thread requirement as

[`joinVoiceGroup(UUID)`](#joinvoicegroup).

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `name` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | the group name; null returns false |

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if the player joined; false if the group or connection is unavailable or another plugin rejects the change

:::

### leaveVoiceGroup {#leavevoicegroup}

::: member

Removes this player from their voice group. Call it on the Minecraft server thread.

**Returns** [`boolean`](/scripting/js/Boolean) — true if the player left; false if there was no group, the voice connection is unavailable or another plugin rejects the change

:::

### getEqualizer {#getequalizer}

::: member

Gets equalizer, pitch and distortion controls for this player's outgoing microphone. Settings are sent to this player's client, which processes PCM before Opus encoding. Every listener hears these effects. For an additional effect heard by one listener, use [`getEqualizerListener(ScriptServerPlayer)`](#getequalizerlistener). Call on the server thread. Settings are shared between handles and reset on reconnect or respawn.

**Returns** [`VoiceServerEqualizer`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerEqualizer) — the player's mutable equalizer, never null

:::

### getReverb {#getreverb}

::: member

Gets reverb for this player's outgoing microphone, after equalization and before encoding. The same client synchronization and lifecycle rules as [`getEqualizer()`](#getequalizer) apply.

**Returns** [`VoiceServerReverb`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerReverb) — the player's mutable reverberator, never null

:::

### getEqualizerListener {#getequalizerlistener}

::: member

Gets additional equalizer, pitch and distortion settings for this speaker as heard by one listener. Only that listener's client processes the decoded voice before playback; other listeners keep their own settings. This layer is applied after the speaker's microphone effects. Call on the server thread. Settings reset if either player reconnects or respawns.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listener` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | the connected listener on the same Minecraft server, not null |

**Returns** [`VoiceServerEqualizer`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerEqualizer) — the shared mutable equalizer for this speaker/listener pair, never null

:::

### getReverbListener {#getreverblistener}

::: member

Gets additional reverb for this speaker as heard by one listener, after the local equalizer. The same synchronization and lifecycle rules as [`getEqualizerListener(ScriptServerPlayer)`](#getequalizerlistener) apply.

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `listener` | [`ScriptServerPlayer`](/scripting/server/entity/ScriptServerPlayer) | the connected listener on the same Minecraft server, not null |

**Returns** [`VoiceServerReverb`](/scripting/server/voice/VoiceServerReverb) — the shared mutable reverberator for this speaker/listener pair, never null

:::

### sendTitle {#sendtitle}

::: member

Shows a big title in the middle of the screen, see [`sendTitleDurations(int, int, int)`](#sendtitledurations).

```js
var player = c.getPlayer();

player.sendTitleDurations(5, 40, 5);
player.sendSubtitle("Get into cover!");
player.sendTitle(scram.text("Quick!").color("red"));
```

| Parameter | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `title` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style) or any value shown as plain text |

:::

| `subtitle` | `Any` | [`ScriptText`](/scripting/common/ScriptText) (keeps its style) or any value shown as plain text |

:::

### playSound {#playsound}

::: member

Plays a sound only to this player, in the master category at full volume and normal pitch.

```js

c.getPlayer().playSound("minecraft:entity.pig.ambient", pos.x, pos.y, pos.z);
```

| `sound` | [`String`](/scripting/js/String) | sound event ID, also from resource packs |

| `y` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | y in blocks |
| `z` | [`double`](/scripting/js/Number) | z in blocks |

:::
